description: ballast rules hook for Codex CLI. Copy to <project>/.codex/hooks.json (one project) or ~/.codex/hooks.json (every project) and replace <BALLAST> with your clone path. Same shape Claude Code loads; same engine; same catalogs (.claude/ballast.rules.json in the project and ~/.claude/). Project hooks load only in a project Codex trusts, and every non-managed hook waits for a one-time review in /hooks — trust is recorded per hash, so edit the command and you review again. commandWindows is optional.
